userStories.title: M9a-3: per-app template apply logic functions — the 'Use template' write path keyed by descriptor key
userStories.description: As a user, I want 'Use template' in the gallery to actually apply a content template through the owning app so that gallery picks create real, fresh objects. Starting state: partial — US-117 shipped the C1 TemplateDescriptor contract + per-app read-only list-template-descriptors logic functions (documents 20, projects 12, accounting 10, drive 4); US-118 shipped the gallery surface but 'Use template' is a host callback with no consumer (phase-13-report line 215: inventing a consumer-side copy would fork the template-copy path the C1 note warns against).
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN M9a verbatim contract (C1): each app exposes its templates through its existing lib constants + a logic function returning descriptors (key, version, labels fr/en, category, preview, required apps, inputs); no new engine/table for built-ins

Each content app (a2e-documents, a2e-projects, a2e-accounting, a2e-drive) gains an apply-template logic function keyed by the same descriptor key, reusing its existing template-copy/instantiation path (documents starter-templates copy helper, projects save-project-as-template payload builders + starter-projects, accounting fiche templates, drive driveFolder tree creation) — fresh IDs on every apply, no aliasing to the template (C1)
Apply validates required apps are installed and inputs are provided; missing requirement → typed error the gallery can render, never a partial apply
Re-apply with the same operation idempotency id creates no duplicates (mirror the M9c acceptance: 'apply creates fresh IDs, re-apply same operation idempotent')
Unit tests per app: apply of one representative descriptor per app produces the expected object set with fresh IDs; unknown key → typed error; missing required app → typed error
Missing for tick (Tier 2, orchestrator): browser round-trip search → preview → use → fresh objects (E15 leg)

Quality gates: for each touched package npx nx lint:diff-with-main <pkg> clean and npx tsgo -p tsconfig.json --noEmit exit 0 (run tsgo directly, not nx typecheck); targeted npx jest specs green with --config=packages/<pkg>/jest.config.mjs; a2e-* app slices: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn test:unit green && npx twenty dev:build . succeeds; bump each touched app's patch version once; no i18n catalog churn (never commit locales/*.po or locales/generated/*); no AI attribution
userStories.notes: Lane L-TPL (a2e-*/src/lib/*template*, starter-*). HIGHEST UNLOCK: this write path is consumed by US-132 (entry-points), US-137 (save-as-template mount), US-150–153 (landing pages' template links), US-163 (M13a chooser), US-169 (M13f undo on apply). Phase-13-report line 215 records the deliberate deferral of exactly this slice.

userStories.title: M10a-3: consume workspace BYOK keys at generation time — wire workspace resolution into AiModelRegistryService.buildModelRegistry
userStories.description: As a workspace admin who saved a provider key in Settings → Syna, I want Syna to actually use that key when generating so that BYOK works end-to-end. Starting state: partial — US-102/127 shipped WorkspaceAiProvider entity, encrypted storage, resolution order and Settings UI, but PLAN M10a annotation: 'AiModelRegistryService.buildModelRegistry is still instance-wide, so a saved workspace key is not yet consumed at generation time (the remaining M10a/M10b server leg)'.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN M10a verbatim resolution order: workspace provider → instance AI_PROVIDERS → catalog (provider-config.service.ts), keeping the 'never template-resolve custom provider values' rule

AiModelRegistryService.buildModelRegistry resolves providers per acting workspace: a saved workspace key is used for that workspace's generations; no workspace key → instance AI_PROVIDERS → catalog fallback unchanged

No cross-workspace leakage: the registry/cache must never serve workspace A's resolved providers to workspace B (if the registry is instance-cached, scope the workspace-resolved segment per request/context — no global mutation)
Billing gating documented for BYOK per PLAN M10a acceptance (entitlement bypass explicit, D-N4 — extend the existing US-102 note if already written)

Integration tests: workspace key consumed at generation time (mocked model call asserts the resolved provider); fallback order (remove key → instance → catalog); cross-workspace isolation (two workspaces, different keys, each gets its own)
Missing for tick (Tier 2, orchestrator): E16 browser journey — admin adds BYOK key → member asks on a page → draft → confirm → remove key; key never in any response/DOM; second workspace unaffected

userStories.title: P4.2 defect: task-calendar GroupByTasks exceeds the GraphQL complexity cap (2001 > 2000) — reduce view group-by complexity

Starting state: defective — PLAN P4.2 annotation 2026-09-24: 'the view's calendar query (GroupByTasks) exceeds the server GraphQL complexity cap (2001 > 2000) and returns null, so the grid renders zero records even though tasks(filter:…) returns the matching task... defect queued for an executor (reduce the view's group-by field/relation complexity)'; the 2026-09-26 auto-commit a2a4932f dropped the project relation column compute-side only.
acceptanceCriteria: PLAN verbatim defect basis: task-calendar.view.ts (a2e-projects) GroupByTasks complexity 2001 > cap 2000 → null data → zero records rendered; fix by reducing the view's group-by field/relation selection, not by raising any cap

The view definition's selected fields/group-by target no longer exceed the server complexity cap: compute (or read via the existing view-field machinery) the query complexity for the view and assert it is ≤ 2000 with margin in a unit test

Do not regress US-059's NULL semantics: the OR filterGroup (IS NOT DONE encoded-array + IS EMPTY) that keeps NULL-projectStatus rows visible while DONE stays excluded must remain exactly as unit-verified
The compute-side repair from a2a4932f (no project relation column) stays; if the render needs project grouping, express it without a relation traversal in the view query
a2e-projects unit suite green including a new complexity assertion test; bump a2e-projects patch version once
Missing for tick (Tier 2, orchestrator): live install → calendar grid renders records for a project with tasks (the exact blocked render from 2026-09-24)
Quality gates: a2e-projects: yarn typecheck && yarn lint && yarn test:unit green && npx twenty dev:build . succeeds; targeted npx jest green; no i18n catalog churn; no AI attribution
userStories.notes: Lane L-NAV-adjacent (a2e-projects views). Real user-facing defect, explicitly queued for an executor in PLAN.md. Unblocks the P4.2 calendar-view Tier-2 proof.
